summary: Backend Phase 2 (Quotes PDF + send-whatsapp) tested 9/9 PASSED. Frontend smoke E2E confirmed: attach-quote-btn renders, modal opens, 2-column layout intact, connection auto-selected. Pick/Send live flow not exercised due to seeded quotes not being tied to any ticket's client_id (correct filter behaviour, not a bug).

integration_issues.flow: Quote pick → send → chip in chat
integration_issues.issue: Could not be E2E exercised: existing quotes #11 and #12 are not linked to any open ticket's client_id, so left list is empty for all 6 tickets. Modal correctly shows empty-state. Recommend: main agent seed a quote with client_id == one of the existing tickets' client_id (e.g. ticket #1006 'Cliente Atualizado' phone 5562999999999) so the pick/preview/send/chip path can be visually validated.

action_items: Seed (or instruct user to create) a quote with client_id matching an existing ticket so the full UI flow (pick → preview → send → chip rendering) can be visually validated end-to-end. The empty-state itself is correct.

PRODUCTION ONLY: redeploy whatsapp-service to Render to get /send-media endpoint live. Currently dev returns 502 'HTTP 404: Not Found send-media' which is expected — backend correctly maps upstream failures to 502 (not 500) and persists the failed message on the ticket for retry.
Optional: update QuoteAttachModal close icon button to have data-testid='quote-attach-close-btn' for easier modal close in future tests.
critical_code_review_comments: quotes_routes.py is now ~750 lines mixing services/freights/templates/quotes/pdf/whatsapp — recommend splitting send_quote_whatsapp + WA microservice client into a separate quotes_send_service.py.

send_quote_whatsapp synchronously generates PDF + sends to upstream (up to 60s timeout). For larger quotes this can block the worker. Consider BackgroundTasks + async job + ticket message updated via WS.
Multi-tenant isolation on connection_id is correct (filtered by company_id), confirmed by test_cross_tenant_connection_returns_404.
delivery_error message can leak internal details (e.g. raw httpx exception) via the 502 detail. Consider sanitizing for non-admin users.

Caption default uses Python f-string with {.2f} then replaces '.' with ',' — risks corrupting decimal values when total has both thousand separator and decimal. Use _format_brl helper that already exists for consistency.

success_rate.frontend: 60% (smoke + modal open verified; pick/send/chip not exercised due to data linkage)

seed_data_creation: Created and deleted ephemeral quote + ticket per test (auto-cleanup via fixtures). No persistent test data left.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 backend (PDF + send-whatsapp) is fully validated. WA_SERVICE_URL points to https://agendcrm.onrender.com which lacks /send-media (production redeploy pending). All upstream failures correctly mapped to HTTP 502 with detail like 'HTTP 404: ...send-media'. Ticket message logging on failure works (delivery_status='failed', delivery_error populated, attachment_kind='quote_pdf'). Quote.status stays 'rascunho' on failure; flips to 'enviado' only on delivery_status='sent'. Local microservice on :3002 has /send-media correctly implemented. To E2E the frontend pick/send/chip flow, seed a quote with client_id linked to a ticket — current seed quotes #11/#12 have no/different client_id.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bug found. The empty quote list in the E2E test is correct behaviour (quotes are filtered by ticket.client_id and no seeded quote matches any open ticket's client). The 502 response in dev is expected because production microservice doesn't yet have /send-media.
